title: Position sizing for the 4H Rosyade-family paper presets
status: registered BEFORE the holdout look; dev statistics only (all data before each symbol's holdout start)
engine: Automate_Execution feat/sizing-research (a259ceb + sizing_mode); default sizing bit-identical to a259ceb
holdout_contamination: The ETH/BTC/SOL 4h holdouts were viewed several times by earlier research (eth-v2 README, MTF README). Any holdout result here is WEAK evidence.
selection_rule: Per family, the largest level whose WORST dev Monte Carlo DD95 over the four presets is >= -40% (10 pp buffer to the Lab's -50% limit: the Lab's MC runs on the full range incl. the holdout, which was worse for ETH). Families are compared at that level by dev Sharpe (1x and 2x costs) and CAGR / |MC DD95|. Rule-aware MC for the drawdown rule. Lookback for vol target fixed at 60 a priori (lb 120 looked better on ETH dev but is not selected on that basis).
dev_findings: Fixed notional: Sharpe is flat in the size (ETH-Basic 1.86-1.92) while MC DD95 scales ~linearly (2x -63%, 1.5x -52%, 1.25x -45%, 1x -38%). The drawdown is a sizing property; the signal sets the Sharpe.
Fixed-fractional on the hard SL LOWERS Sharpe on ETH (1.64 vs 1.89) and SOL (1.24 vs 1.37): the long SL (13% ETH, 29% SOL) is far from the realised risk (trailing exits), so longs get under-sized.
Vol target 60% (lb 60): same risk-adjusted return as fixed 1x within noise (ETH-Basic Sharpe 1.90 vs 1.89, v2 1.89 vs 1.80, SOL 1.40 vs 1.37, BTC 1.01 vs 1.05); per-year wins are split.

DD de-risk (1.5x, halve below -20% closed-equity DD): best rule-aware MC DD95 per unit of CAGR, but on the real dev path it cut return (Sharpe 1.82 vs 1.91 at 1.5x) without lowering the realised max DD (-28.6 vs -28.8). Its benefit exists only under the iid reshuffle assumption; not registered.

R2_vol_target_60.paper: not mirrorable by the paper engine today (sizes on SL distance / leverage cap)

holdout_procedure: ONE Lab validate run per preset x {R1, R2} (8 runs) through the normal Lab pipeline on a /tmp copy of production lab.db, holdout locks pinned to the starts above. No re-runs, no parameter changes after.

decision_criteria.primary: R1 is recommended if its full-range MC DD95 (Lab check) is > -50% for 4H-ETH-Basic and 4H-ETH-v2.
decision_criteria.R2_over_R1: R2 replaces R1 only if, on the holdout, R2 has a higher Sharpe than R1 for BOTH ETH presets AND passes the MC DD95 check for both; otherwise R1 (simpler, paper-native).
expected_not_fixable_by_sizing: 4H-ETH-Basic holdout PF 1.03 < 1.2 (PF is ~size-invariant) -> verdict stays FAIL
4H-BTC-Opt and 4H-SOL-Opt holdout trades < 30 -> verdict stays FAIL
